data: Awesome music, great graphics, and tons of fun
From an absolute banger soundtrack to the ever so amazing gameplay and hundreds of hours of fun
Amazing game with really good graphics
if you are a lot more casual or just need new THPS content, definitely worth buying
Still a great game to kick back and play with friends
Don't buy this game until this always-online DRM is gone

Try to only get this game if your PC can handle games from 2020. But I don't recommend this game if you prefer playing Pro Skater 3 and 4, and for game that has walking like THUG1, THUG2, THAW, and THP8 (SD). Only get this game if you don't want to play the PS1 versions of those games with the new skating mechanics. If you're gonna try to 100%, good luck with the huge grind to it thanks to TannerJaye for showing the Platinum video for this game and how it was. In general, feel free to pick it up and just beat the game and unlock all levels if needed for your family, friends or kids to play for multiplayer or online.
everything I was hoping it to be- it's a loving redux of the classic game. I've been having a blast grinding down memory lane in HD

The music alone is the main reason to buy this game (except for the new tracks). It's a good thing they come with a damn fun game to play with. It's a good old fashioned arcade like game anyone can play and have a good time.

Relived some good childhood memories. Soundtrack still slaps. Game plays buttery smooth, satisfying learning curve as you can feel yourself getting better over time. Used a forum post from 2009 to work out what a death grind gap was.
It is a very good remake, although I miss some of the original sounds effects.

Purchased but refunded. Why? Well, not my type of TH game.

But I'll still recommend it. For people that loved playing the Pro Skater series, this is a blessing. The gameplay is nice, the graphics are awesome and it's all there. The caveat is the always online requirement. Aside from that, solid game through and through.

I'll wait for the day when they decide to remake American Wasteland, as this is the one that I like the most and grew up playing. I need a silly ridiculous and nonsensical quasi-story to motivate me to do insane tricks. Just beating scores and challenges don't do it for me ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Wonderful remake, but it doesn't work with a multiple monitor setup. It always switches to the second one. This problem has been around for five years and still hasn't been fixed. I don't think it ever will be because the studio is dead.

I miss Spidey but it's Pro Skater and feels good to play + looks nice.
I wish create-a-skater was a bit more advanced but probably would have added to this game's budget a lot.

Activision being absolute dogshit as per usual. Bit of fun and a throw back to the good old days.
If you got this to play with your friends you're shit out of luck. By the looks of it, you haven't been able to have a party with the boiz since late 2022. You'd think something that's easily fixable after over a year of being cooked and dropping their player count. Useless cogs
THPS 1+2 is an incredibly well-crafted remake and an absolute joy to play. Tons of levels to 100%, gaps to unlock, more than 800 challenges and MP on top of that. Highly recommended!

Finally, I'm not trapped on Epic anymore! Hail Lord Gaben!!!

THPS 1 + 2 is seriously the best thing that's happened to the series in a LONGGG time. Honestly, I'd have to rate it the best out of all the THPS games. They remade 1 & 2 into basically, one game. The combo strings you can do are great. It's just a straight up fantastic game.

Another thing I need to discuss is the soundtrack. The OST combines MOST of the songs from both games and adds new ones, which personally I think is very cool since THPS exposed me and many other kids to some great music. Why not go for it again? I found myself enjoying a lot of the new soundtrack.

9/10 - I rarely rate anything a 9. But THPS 1& 2 holds a dear place in my childhood gaming memories, as well as many others. THPS2 was probably my most played game back in the PS1 days. If you are any kind of THPS fan, this is a NECESSITY!! I can't recommend it enough

A great PC remaster of the original classics. The games have aged great and it really feels like movement system in the original games was just copied over and pasted in a great looking new engine with the only change being the get up function so when you spam A you get up quicker. I feel great for holding off on the EPIC exclusive window, as I wanted to play this on Steam Deck. The game's great on Deck and they recently put out a proper offline mode that has made it easier to play when I dont have Wifi. Pretty upset that there wont be a 3-4, at least under the old Activision leadership which has changed recently. Do not sleep on this, even if you haven't played it as a kid back in the day, it holds up extremely well.

Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 and 2 Remastered absolutely nails the nostalgia. I grew up with these games, and playing them again felt exactly like I remembered, just with a fresh coat of paint and the same banger soundtrack still hitting. My one real gripe is the missing bonus characters. Where is my Spider-Man? I know licensing is a nightmare and that's why he and a few others didn't make the cut, but those unlockables were genuinely part of the heart of the originals for me. Still, an excellent remaster and easily worth the price of admission for any old-school skater.
Back to memories... 41 years and I will never forget when we left school, we smoked weed and had a good time, thank you TH

Fantastic game, but man fuck Blizzard-Activistion for merging Vicarious Visions into Blizzard and turning them into "Blizzard Albany", whatever that means.

It means being sent to the World of Warcraft mines, obviously.

Also please remove the always-online DRM implementation, it's completely pointless and stupid for a game that's mostly single-player. THPS1+2 has already been pirated anyway, might as well give up this pointless fight against piracy.

As far as I know you don't need the internet to play the Switch version on the go. I'd like to play this game on my Steam Deck while taking the train or the plane, but apparently that's a no-go.

You better not screw up THPS3+4.
It's Tony Hawk 1 & 2 but with a massive graphical overhaul. What's not to like? It's perfect.

Great Remake, hoping they make a 3+4 one day.

If you want more thps content after finishing this game, please download the thugpro mod.
This remaster shreds with tight controls, sick lines, and a soundtrack that slaps harder than a primo bail. Pure skate bliss, no filler.
It's a great game. But as long as the ramp 2 roof gap on venice beach isn't fixed, I have to thumbs down.

A fantastic remaster of two classic games, with seemingly all the original skaters and music. If you're a fan of the originals there is a lot to like here.

Here's to hoping Activision can find a way to give THPS3 and THPS4 the same treatment.
Shredding on hanger while faded than a ho and listening to deftones is just bomb bro

I'm sure the braindead corpo chimp that made these decisions got a sweet bonus for kneecapping this IP though so the system is working as intended.

Was enjoying this until I tried to play on a tuesday, the Steam servers went down for maintenance as they do every week and I found out this is an always-online singleplayer game. You cannot play this offline without modifying it. Just pirate it. Fuck this cancerous nonsense.

amazing and faithful remake. absolutely love it, brings back chilhood memories from the 90s, expeically the music. everything is how i remembered it. however i am giving it a negative review because of the mandatory online. this doesn't make senese because alot of us are playing handheld via steam deck, this game is theoretically unplayable while traveling which is the appeal of mobile gaming unless u stay tethered to a phone. if the publisher fixes this issue i will make sure to change my review to positive because it deserves it

edit: steam banned my thread because i was calling out the bs of the "always online" requirement and how everyone should leave bad reviews. what a bunch of jokers man trying to silence me, "power to the players"

Beautifully remastered, and learning how to play the game (and watching yourself become better and better at it in real time) is the peak of all dopamine hits. There's some hidden unlockable content too which I thought was neat. You should really consider buying it if you're looking for a fun casual game
It straight up doesn't work if you have more than 1 monitor active. It crashes instantly.

You can spend hours in that game and never start playing, thanks to the shittiest and longest menu navigation imaginable. To close this game without Alt + F4, you need 6 clicks and 3 animations. To swap free skate to a single session on the same map, you need over 10 clicks. And the game was created by Activision. You will be forced to know that because they put an unskippable intro with this, but don't worry there is a skippable intro later but is laggy for no reason. The game itself is great.
Perfect. A real pleasure to play and see those nostalgic levels once again in a modern graphics engine. Gameplay still holds up and is probably better than the original games.

I'm addicted.... I have to mention that I've actually purchased this twice, once on console, but no longer have that, and while I did complete so much on console, I had no issue doing it again, in fact, I'm addicted at this point. I can't stop until I finish the legend challenges and hit level 100, gonna need to play hundreds of multiplayer games and I don't mind it at all. This is a true to it's roots duo remake that brings me back. It is 100% worth it and you won't be disappointed. Be on the lookout for THPS 3 + 4 on July 11th, I know I will be.

One of the best remasters for one of the most nostalgic and greatest games.

This remaster upgrades all that is good from the original 2 games from graphics, character creation and game-play whilst still a similar yet great experience to the originals.

In addition to all this, there is also an expanded soundtrack that included all track from the originals (except 2 due to licensing) along with some more modern songs. Personally I dislike some of the new tracks and some of them I do enjoy and if this is also the case for you, you can edit what songs play by selecting the "Playlist" options in the Sound Options menu.

And finally, all of the maps you have come to love have all been gracefully remade with better visuals, lighting and textures, along with all the same secrets and gaps.

My only annoyance with the game is that is always has to be online but it hasn't impacted me much as I usually have my internet on when playing games.

Rating 10/10,
Worth the full price but as always if you can get it cheaper then go for it.
addicting and brings me back to my childhood - but with a rather fresh feeling since it's been so long

This is a great game!! I used to play this way back on the Playstation (PS1 for young people). Still as amazing as it used to be with better graphics. I can't wait to see if the others get released for PC as well with a graphical and game engine update.
just as awesome, if not better than when it first came out, the soundtrack has been ingrained in me from back when my friends would be playing it during band practice. good times great memories.

super addicted to this game right now i been playing it non-stop it even motivated me to try skating in real life. I tried my favourite trick ''christ air'' over a subway station and lost both my legs in the process now i'm in a wheelchair for the rest of my life.. wicked game 10/10
Runs at a near perfect 60 fps on the steam deck. All I can ask for.
It's THPS, I grew up with this, you grew up with this, the music is rad, the gameplay is awesome, the updated graphics are excellent. What isn't to love? Waiting for 3+4.

Not as great as a soundtrack as the original and has a decent chunk of modern influence over sticking to the previous design.

Overall though, a pretty solid game. Especially if you grew up with this series.
If you have been longing for a new Pro Skater game for years like I have, this will sate your thirst.
In tony Hawk you get to fly like a eagle, which is very poetic because that's not his name
They don't include any of the DLC in the Deluxe Edition, so save your money.

NOSTALGIA.

Game is still great, and there is not much more fun than button smashing and making Rodney Mullen into a behemoth on the pipe and then into the most insane combo including nolly's, olly's and everything inbetween too

this game is fucking horrible i hate it so much that my friends all bought it so that we could play together and just be like "oh my fuck this game is so fucking dogshit dude i cant wait to play again tomorrow" yeah i would totally recommend that everyone buys this game and plays it until their stupid fat little fingies go numb and they piss and shit their pants so they could all have the same experience that i did
Very nostalgic! Changed the key combo setup to suit my liking. I wish there were additional parks and challenges one could download.
If you like to do tricks and combo's, this is it. Nostalgic as hell, i was like 15 when I was playing this, now I am 38. Still loves it!

A great mix of a sports high-scorer and a collectathon.
Would highly recommend if not for the always online component.
EDIT: The game previously had always online, getting reports from SteamDeck users that this isn't the case anymore so I've changed to recommended, game is still great fun and online is a great chill sesh.
Nostalgic with graphics. Really the game for grown-ups that only have maybe 1-2 hour best for gaming.

As difficult and as addicting as I remembered it to be. I was only able to play 4 back on the PS1, but the remake captures the beauty and the magic of the originals. 10/10

I recommend this for both newcomers of the series and fans of the original Tony Hawks Pro Skater. A must have on the Steam Deck as well.

Definitely getting 3+4 as well when it releases.

I'm not a big skateboarding fan, so take my review with a grain of salt. This game is a lot of fun. The controls kind of confuse me, but that's a me problem and not a problem with the game. The graphics are great and it's fun to play. What more could you ask for?
This game is only good if you only enjoy the original 2 games. You'd think it'd be an update to the games to make them in a newer style, but no.

Amazing game, however cant recommend at the moment due to the always online requirement. Why does this have one for single player? Makes playing on Steam deck a pita. Will change to positive when/if this stupid requirement is removed.

EDIT - Have now changed to positive as they have removed the online requirement for the Steam Deck at least. It's still there on desktop. This shouldn't be the case for the single player, its bad practice and should be called out for what it is - bs. The game otherwise is outstanding and does deserve a recommendation regardless though.
My favorite game of all time I have 100% this on every platform I have besides the Nintendo Switch which is next 10/10 wish they would make it crossplay to make it even better
